deleteChartText: Delete chart "%s" with all its states?
noChartsHelp: Create a chart with the "+" button on the left.
Name: Name
chartHelp: Drag from the edge of a state to another state to create a transition. Drop a state into another state to make it a sub state, drag it out again to undo it. Select a state or transition to edit it.
actionsHelp: JavaScript using the variables, e.g. light = true; count++;
Label: Label
labelHelp: event[condition]{action}, every part is optional. Event: name of an input, or a temporal expression like after(5, sec), before(...), at(...), every(...), after(3, input), after(5, min, condition) or at("sunset", -30)
priorityHelp: Transitions of the same state are checked in this order
symbolsHelp: Inputs are read from ioBroker states and wake up the chart when they change. Outputs are written to states. Locals only live inside the chart.
%s() needs a variable of the chart as fi: %s() needs a variable of the chart as first argument
Unknown event \"%s\", use the name of an: Unknown event "%s", use the name of an input
Input \"%s\" is overwritten on its next: Input "%s" is overwritten on its next change
functionHelp: JavaScript, executed once when the chart starts. The functions and constants declared here can be used in all conditions and actions of this chart.
\"%s\" is declared in more than one func: "%s" is declared in more than one function block
\"%s\" is already the name of a variable: "%s" is already the name of a variable
Leave and enter the parent state again: Leave and enter the parent state again
innerTransitionHelp: Inner transition (dot at the start): the state stays active, only its active child is left. Its entry and exit actions are not executed. Checked after its during action.
outerToChildHelp: The state is left and entered again: its exit and entry actions are executed. Checked before its during action, like all transitions leaving it.
generatedCodeHelp: JavaScript generated from the chart. It shows how the adapter executes the chart: the XState machine and the functions which select the transitions on every wakeup. It is for reading only, changes have no effect.
generatedCodeUnsaved: It includes the unsaved changes, the adapter still executes the saved chart.
Restore the state after a restart: Restore the state after a restart
restoreStateHelp: After a restart of the adapter or of ioBroker, the chart continues in the states which were active before, with its local variables and the remaining time of its timers. The entry actions are not executed again. After saving the chart or pausing it, it always starts in the initial state.
unsavedChangesText: The chart "%s" has unsaved changes. Save them before showing another chart?
importedCharts: %s chart(s) imported. They are paused: check the variables, then start them.
noteHelp: Notes are only for the documentation, they have no influence on the execution. Drop a note into a state, so it moves together with it.
commentHelp: Only for the documentation, shown as tooltip and in the generated code
triggerHelp: When this input wakes up the chart. Updates filtered out by ack do not change the variable. With debounce, the chart wakes up only after the input had no update for this time, with its last value.
Show live values: Show the live values of the variables
Hide live values: Hide the live values of the variables
historyHelp: Starts of the chart and the transitions taken, newest first. Click a transition to select it. The adapter keeps the last 200 events, also after a restart.
noHistory: Nothing happened yet. The history is filled while the chart runs.
Take transitions until none is valid (su: Take transitions until none is valid (super step)
superStepHelp: Off: one transition per wakeup, the next one waits for the next wakeup. On: after a transition, the chart is checked again right away, until no transition is valid anymore (at most %s). Events of inputs only count for the first transition. During actions can be executed several times per wakeup.
anchorsHelp: The ends of a transition are placed automatically on the borders of its states. Select the transition and drag the round grips at its ends along the border to fix them at another place, or drop a grip on another state to move the transition there.
endGripAutomatic: Placed automatically. Drag along the border to fix this end there, or drop it on another state to move the transition there.
endGripFixed: Fixed at this place. Drag along the border to move it, or drop it on another state to move the transition there. Double click: place it automatically again.
parallelHelp: Off: exactly one of the states is active (OR). On: all of them are active at the same time (AND), shown with a dashed border. On every wakeup, they are processed one after the other in their execution order. Transitions between parallel states are not possible.
Return to the last active sub state (his: Return to the last active sub state (history)
historyJunctionHelp: Like the history junction (H) of Stateflow: entering the state returns to the sub state which was active when it was left last, e.g. to the former automatic mode after "Manual". The initial state is only used the first time. This applies to all transitions ending at the state, not to those leading to one of its sub states.
historyJunctionTitle: History junction: entering the state returns to the last active sub state
executionOrderHelp: The parallel states are processed in this order, lower first. Without a number, after the others. Currently position %s.
executionOrderTitle: Parallel state, position %s in the execution order
Transitions between parallel states are: Transitions between parallel states are not possible
The condition is never true, the transit: The condition is never true, the transition is never taken
The state never becomes active: no trans: The state never becomes active: no transition leads to it
Never taken: the transition to \"%s\" be: Never taken: the transition to "%s" before it is always valid
Never taken: the transition to "%s" before it has the same event and condition
The chart stays in this state: neither i: The chart stays in this state: neither it nor a state containing it has an outgoing transition
The input is not used, it only wakes up: The input is not used, it only wakes up the chart
The variable is written but never read: The variable is written but never read
Unknown input \"%s\", use a time unit (m: Unknown input "%s", use a time unit (msec, sec, min) or the name of an input
Invalid temporal expression \"%s\", expe: Invalid temporal expression "%s", expected e.g. after(5, sec), every(10, min), after(3, button), after(5, min, condition) or at("sunset", -30)
Unknown time \"%s\", use a time like \"2: Unknown time "%s", use a time like "22:30" or one of: %s
getState() needs the ID of the state as: getState() needs the ID of the state as text, e.g. getState("0_userdata.0.temperature")
simulationStartTitle: Start simulation: the chart as shown here runs without writing outputs, the inputs are set by hand
simulatedValueHelp: New value, set with Enter: a number, true/false, or text
simulatedEventHelp: Wake up the chart with the event of this input, without changing its value
Breakpoint: the simulation stops when th: Breakpoint: the simulation stops when the state is entered
Breakpoint: the simulation stops when the transition is taken
Pause: events wait until the next step: Pause: events wait until the next step
Single step: process the next waiting ev: Single step: process the next waiting event
Advance the time to the next timer: Advance the time to the next timer
Advance the time, timers due meanwhile f: Advance the time, the timers due meanwhile fire
